name: Conflicting invoice evidence
objective: Validate that conflicting evidence triggers human review instead of arbitrary source selection.

input.ticket: Invoice 5100002002 is blocked, but a support note provided with the ticket says there is no price difference for this invoice. Please determine the cause.

additional_evidence.statement: There is no price difference between the purchase order and invoice.

must_not: Arbitrarily declare the ticket attachment incorrect.
Arbitrarily declare the mock SAP data incorrect.
Confirm a root cause before resolving the evidence conflict.
